description: §61.2 / §66.2.2 — a typed attribute on `<endpoint>` (`x:string="*"`) makes the opener a declaration, and a declaration named `endpoint` is E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED (§4.15). impl#1 reports E-ENDPOINT-ATTR-INVALID there (a recorded divergence, carried).
rationale: §61.2: "A typed attribute (`x:cors=\"*\"`, `x:int=3`) is not an endpoint attribute: it makes the opener a declaration (§66.2.2 \"at least one typed attribute\"), and a declaration named `endpoint` is `E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED` (§4.15)".
